quote: “Let the tears of the poor man find with thee more compassion, but not more justice, than the pleadings of the rich.”
source: Miguel de Cervantes, Don Quixote, Part II, chapter 42 (Don Quixote, to Sancho Panza) (trans. John Ormsby, 1885)
speaker: Don Quixote, counselling Sancho Panza before he governs his island
